@@U01058@@
Yes, but just one more glance in the glass. That woman’s image was too beautiful for words!

@@U01060@@
No, no! You'll see her soon in the flesh, that paragon of all earthly beauty.

@@U01061@@
(Aside.)

@@U01062@@
With that swill in his belly, every housewife will look a 海伦 to him.

@@U01064@@
浮士德 advances on 格蕾琴 as she passes by.

@@U01066@@
Lovely lady, may I offer you my arm and be your escort?

@@U01068@@
I’m neither lovely nor a lady. And I can get home without your help, thank you.

@@U01069@@
(She disengages herself and goes out.)

@@U01071@@
Great Heaven, what a beautiful child! I’ve never seen anything like her. Modest, virtuous, unspoiled, but not without some snap in her, too. The red of her lips, her cheeks’ glow— can I ever forget them? And the way she cast down her eyes stirred me to the core. And the way she cut me short! Enchanting!
translation:
@@U01058@@
是的，但只是再看一眼。那女人的形象美得无法用言语来形容！

@@U01060@@
不，不！你很快就会看到她的真身，她是世间一切美丽的典范。

@@U01061@@
（旁边。）

@@U01062@@
他肚子里有这口臭味，每个家庭主妇在他眼里都是海伦。

@@U01064@@
当格蕾琴经过时，浮士德向她靠近。

@@U01066@@
可爱的女士，我可以伸出我的手臂为您护航吗？

@@U01068@@
我既不可爱，也不淑女。不用你帮忙我也能回家，谢谢你。

@@U01069@@
（她挣脱束缚，走出去。）

@@U01071@@
伟大的天堂，多么美丽的孩子啊！我从来没有见过像她这样的人。谦虚、贤惠、未受宠坏，但她也不乏脾气。她红润的嘴唇，她红润的脸颊——我能忘记它们吗？她垂下眼睛的样子深深地触动了我。还有她打断我的方式！妖娆！
